profile.headline: Software Engineer at Cisco
profile.summary: Passionate, solution-oriented technologist with strong interests and background in open source software, network security, and information technology. Dedicated and adaptive analytical thinker and problem solver, attentive to both current and potential future needs. Adept at supporting users of technology at different expertise levels, and within different market sectors and types of organizations -- from small businesses to Fortune 100 corporations.

positions.title: Quality Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and performed quality assurance (QA) testing on the Cisco security platform, focused on firewalls and firewall management, with a specialty in complete end-to-end solutions involving diverse combinations of products.

Partnered with documentation, product development, and product management teams to ensure the go-to-market quality of new features and offerings.

Maintained lab environments used for quality testing.

positions.title: Information Technology System Support Administrator
positions.description:
Provided internal (library staff) and external (public customer) users with desktop computer and peripheral support. 

Installed, maintained, and upgraded physical and virtual servers in the core infrastructure.

Served as a backup to the network engineer to resolve networking issues.

Assisted in the training of library staff on how to most productively use software and hardware.

positions.title: Serials Assistant
positions.description:
Checked in newly-arrived materials for the library collection.

Filed loose-leaf updates and pocket part supplements for various legal publications.

Performed maintenance on serials records in the integrated library system (Innovative Millennium).

Assisted in solving problems with duplicates and missing items.

Created a database application (in Microsoft Access) to better facilitate returns of duplicate, erroneous and non-approved items to vendors.

Served on the Integrated Library System and Electronic Resources and Services Forums.

Assisted in other serials projects as needed.

positions.title: Library Assistant, Special Collections
positions.description:
Arranged and described agriculture-related collections.

Assisted and supervised patrons in Special Collections Reading Room.

Assisted in physical maintenance of collections.

Created and maintained databases related to the contents and use of collections.

Digitized images for patrons and library staff.

Prepared digital media to fulfill patron and staff requests.
